Additional small CD61-positive cells and platelet fragments are scattered in the interstitium, raising the possibility of micromegakaryocytes. The remaining hematopoietic cells are negative. Findings support megakaryocytic dysplasia with clustering in a myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: MPN clusters contain large hyperlobated or cloud-like megakaryocytes rather than small multinucleated forms with separate nuclei.
Reactive megakaryocytes are dispersed and have normally lobulated nuclei.
AMKL shows sheets of small CD61-positive blasts rather than scattered maturing megakaryocytes.

61695.recognize_zh: 400 倍 H&E 下黃色三角框內可見多個巨大、成熟的巨核細胞緊密群聚，細胞核過度分葉、呈鹿角狀（staghorn），胞質豐富，這種大型成熟巨核細胞聚集是 ET 的典型線索。
features: Clusters of markedly enlarged megakaryocytes (highlighted by yellow triangle and arrow)
Hyperlobulated, deeply folded 'staghorn' nuclei with mature chromatin
Abundant eosinophilic, mature-appearing cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes loosely to tightly clustered, admixed with erythroid and granulocytic precursors
No hypolobated, bulbous or cloud-like dysplastic megakaryocytes identified in this field
Adjacent bony trabecula at lower left; fibrosis cannot be assessed on H&E
61695.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section (H&E, 400x) shows trilineage hematopoiesis with increased megakaryocytes forming loose to tight clusters (marked by the yellow triangle and arrow). The megakaryocytes are large to giant with abundant mature cytoplasm and hyperlobulated, staghorn-like nuclei. No small hypolobated forms or bizarre cloud-like nuclei with abnormal chromatin clumping are seen in this field, and granulocytic and erythroid elements are present in the background. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular (JAK2/CALR/MPL) context; a reticulin stain is needed to exclude prefibrotic primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with bulbous, hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei and high N:C ratio in dense clusters with increased cellularity and granulocytic proliferation, whereas ET megakaryocytes are large, mature and staghorn-lobated.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of variable size and prominent erythroid hyperplasia, rather than predominantly giant hyperlobulated megakaryocytes in normocellular marrow.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but normal in size and lobation and do not form tight clusters, with no driver mutation.
This also has large megakaryocytes but shows dyserythropoiesis with >=15% ring sideroblasts on iron stain and SF3B1 mutation.

61631.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見大量大型異型細胞，核大、空泡狀染色質、核仁明顯且核膜不規則，大小約為小淋巴球的兩到三倍，散布於造血細胞之間；此放大倍率下無法確認血管/竇內分布，需以 CD20 與 CD34 雙染等免疫染色證實血管內生長。
features: Numerous large atypical cells (2-3 times small lymphocyte size) with vesicular chromatin
Prominent nucleoli and irregular, indented or cleaved nuclear contours
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; occasional mitotic figure
Large cells distributed interstitially among residual hematopoietic cells and small lymphocytes
Intrasinusoidal/intravascular localization not clearly demonstrable at this magnification on H&E
61631.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow containing numerous large atypical lymphoid-appearing cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli, irregular nuclear contours, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, admixed with residual hematopoietic elements and small lymphocytes. A predominantly intrasinusoidal distribution is not clearly evident on this H&E field. Immunohistochemistry for CD20/PAX5 together with an endothelial marker (CD34 or ERG) is required to demonstrate intravascular/intrasinusoidal localization; with such confirmation, findings would be consistent with involvement by intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS involving marrow
ddx.vs: Systemic DLBCL forms extravascular paratrabecular or diffuse masses, whereas IVLBCL cells are confined to sinusoids and capillaries as highlighted by CD34/CD20 double staining.
Myeloblasts have fine chromatin and less vesicular nuclei, and are CD34/CD117/MPO-positive rather than CD20/PAX5-positive.

ddx.dx: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis or reactive large cells
ddx.vs: HLH shows histiocytes with phagocytosed hematopoietic cells and bland nuclei, lacking atypical B-cells with prominent nucleoli.
Morphology is identical; the NK/T-cell form is CD20-negative, CD3ε/CD56-positive, and EBER-positive.

61567.recognize_zh: 大量中至大型異常前骨髓球，胞質充滿粗大紫紅色顆粒而遮蓋核邊界，箭頭處細胞可見多條交錯的 Auer 小體（faggot cell 樣），符合高顆粒型急性前骨髓性白血病（APL）。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large abnormal promyelocytes replacing normal marrow elements
Cytoplasm packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules that obscure the nuclear outline
Arrowed cell with multiple crisscrossing Auer rods (faggot-like cell)
Round to reniform nuclei with partly obscured, moderately fine chromatin
Occasional small mature lymphocytes and a disrupted granular cell cluster at right; background with platelet/granule debris
61567.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular field dominated by abnormal promyelocytes. The cells are medium to large with round to reniform nuclei largely obscured by dense, coarse azurophilic granules; the arrowed cell contains multiple bundled Auer rods (faggot cell). Maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors are not appreciated in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type; confirmation of PML::RARA/t(15;17) should be expedited given the risk of coagulopathy.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation shows myeloblasts with single thin Auer rods plus a spectrum of maturing neutrophils, not a sheet of heavily granular promyelocytes with bundled Auer rods.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte hyperplasia (marrow recovery after G-CSF or agranulocytosis)
ddx.vs: Recovering marrow shows promyelocytes with a clear Golgi zone, normal granules and no Auer rods, and is followed by synchronous maturation rather than a monotonous arrested population.

ddx.dx: APL with variant RARA rearrangement (e.g. ZBTB16::RARA)
ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap (variant cases may show regular nuclei and fewer faggot cells), so FISH/RT-PCR for PML::RARA is needed because variant translocations are ATRA-resistant.

61503.recognize_zh: 六格合成圖：A–C 周邊血液中出現多個漿母細胞樣細胞（深嗜鹼性豐富細胞質、偏心核、核旁淡染區），D 為骨髓抹片混合細胞與巨噬細胞，E、F 為免疫染色（E 成群陽性、F 僅單一核陽性，推測為 HHV8 LANA 等標記，圖中未標示）；循環中的漿母細胞是 HHV8 相關淋巴增生疾患的線索。
features: Panel A: several circulating atypical lymphoid cells with dark nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm at low power
Panels B-C: medium to large plasmablastic cells with eccentric nuclei, open chromatin, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with a perinuclear hof
Panel C also shows a neutrophil and an immature granulocyte for size comparison
Panel D: marrow aspirate with mixed hematopoietic cells, plasmacytoid cells, and a large histiocyte
Panel E: immunostain with clusters of strongly positive cells; panel F: immunostain with a single nuclear-positive cell (antibodies not labeled)
Image resolution is low, limiting assessment of nucleoli and inclusions
61503.describe_en: This composite figure shows peripheral blood smears (A-C), a bone marrow aspirate (D), and two immunohistochemical stains (E-F). The blood smears contain increased circulating plasmablast-like cells with eccentric nuclei, dispersed chromatin, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with a perinuclear hof. The marrow aspirate shows mixed hematopoietic elements with plasmacytoid cells and a histiocyte, while the immunostains show clusters of positive cells (E) and a rare nuclear-positive cell (F), although the antibodies are not labeled and resolution is limited. In the appropriate context, and with confirmation by HHV8 LANA staining, light-chain restriction studies, and EBV status, the findings are suggestive of an HHV8-associated lymphoproliferative disorder with circulating plasmablasts, such as HHV8-positive multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Plasma cell leukemia cells are more mature plasma cells that are HHV8 negative, CD138+, and usually CD20 negative, with myeloma-type cytogenetics.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is typically EBER positive and HHV8 negative, forming destructive masses of plasmablasts.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: This entity forms sheets of LANA+, IgM lambda-restricted plasmablasts effacing tissue, whereas MCD shows scattered plasmablasts in the mantle zones.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis (e.g., viral infection or dengue)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytes are polytypic and HHV8 LANA negative, with a spectrum of maturation.

61375.recognize_zh: 細支氣管柱狀纖毛上皮被成群、細胞質淡染的單核樣（monocytoid）淋巴細胞浸潤並破壞變形，形成淋巴上皮病灶（lymphoepithelial lesion），周圍為密集的小淋巴球浸潤，符合 MALT 淋巴瘤。
features: Bronchiolar lumen lined by ciliated columnar epithelium that is partially preserved on one side
Epithelium infiltrated and distorted by clusters of lymphoid cells, forming lymphoepithelial lesions
Infiltrating cells are small to medium monocytoid B cells with irregular nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
Dense surrounding infiltrate of small lymphocytes with slightly irregular nuclei in the peribronchiolar tissue
Thin fibrous septa separating the infiltrate; no large-cell sheets in this field
61375.describe_en: Lung section shows a bronchiole surrounded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate. Clusters of small to medium monocytoid lymphocytes with moderate pale cytoplasm infiltrate and distort the bronchiolar epithelium, forming lymphoepithelial lesions, while the adjacent parenchyma is effaced by small lymphocytes. Sheets of large cells are not seen. Findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma), to be supported by CD20 positivity with cytokeratin highlighting epithelial destruction and demonstration of light chain restriction or clonal IGH rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Reactive bronchus-associated lymphoid tissue hyperplasia / follicular bronchiolitis
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous with reactive follicles and polytypic plasma cells and lack destructive monocytoid B-cell lymphoepithelial lesions.
LIP expands alveolar septa with polyclonal T and B cells without mass-forming effacement or clonal B cells.

ddx.dx: Small lymphocytic lymphoma / mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are CD5-positive and only rarely form lymphoepithelial lesions; cyclin D1 identifies mantle cell lymphoma and CD23/LEF1 identify SLL.
Carcinoma cells are cohesive, keratin positive and CD45 negative, whereas the cells here are discohesive lymphoid cells within the epithelium.

61247.recognize_zh: 這是胸部 CT 冠狀切面肺窗，不是形態學圖：雙肺可見小葉間隔增厚與網狀、細結節狀陰影，以左下肺較明顯，並沿支氣管血管束分布；在已知癌症病人身上，這種間隔與支氣管血管周圍增厚提示癌性淋巴管炎（lymphangitic carcinomatosis）。
features: Coronal chest CT reconstruction in lung window
Smooth to nodular interlobular septal thickening and reticular opacities, most evident in the left lower lobe
Peribronchovascular interstitial thickening radiating from the left hilum
Scattered small nodules along vessels and fissures
No large consolidation or pleural effusion clearly seen on this single slice
61247.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic coronal chest CT image in lung window. It shows interlobular septal thickening with reticular and fine nodular opacities, most pronounced in the left lower lobe, along with peribronchovascular interstitial thickening extending from the hilum and scattered small perivascular nodules. There is no dense consolidation on this image. In a patient with known metastatic carcinoma, the pattern of nodular septal and peribronchovascular thickening is consistent with lymphangitic carcinomatosis; tissue confirmation or clinical correlation is required.

ddx.vs: Produces smooth, symmetric septal thickening with ground-glass opacity, cardiomegaly and effusions, and resolves with diuresis.
Shows perilymphatic nodules predominantly in the upper lobes with symmetric hilar lymphadenopathy.
Tends to show ground-glass opacity or tree-in-bud nodules with an acute clinical course and positive microbiology.

61119.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下，致密的小淋巴球與漿細胞樣細胞浸潤包圍並穿插在汗腺（eccrine）導管與腺體之間，附屬器結構被浸潤分隔，呈破壞性、浸潤性分布，是皮膚邊緣區淋巴瘤的結構線索。
features: Dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate surrounding and separating eccrine ducts and coils
Infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei and plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Some cells with paler cytoplasm (monocytoid features) admixed
Adnexal epithelium intact but encased and infiltrated by the lymphoid cells
No sheets of large transformed cells; collagen bundles at the periphery
61119.describe_en: Section of skin shows a dense, diffuse lymphoid infiltrate in the dermis that surrounds and percolates between eccrine ducts and secretory coils, separating the adnexal structures. The infiltrate consists predominantly of small lymphocytes with slightly irregular nuclei and plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, admixed with cells having paler cytoplasm. Large transformed cells are not conspicuous. The destructive, adnexa-infiltrating pattern supports a lymphoma, and in conjunction with immunostains and light-chain ISH the findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the skin.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are usually top-heavy with well-formed germinal centers and polytypic plasma cells, and they spare rather than permeate adnexa.
Syringotropic MF shows atypical T cells infiltrating eccrine epithelium with syringolymphoid hyperplasia and a CD4+ T-cell phenotype.
Plasmacytoma consists of sheets of plasma cells without a significant small B-cell and T-cell component.
Lupus shows periadnexal lymphocytes with interface change, dermal mucin and polytypic plasma cells.

61055.recognize_zh: 流式顯示 kappa 輕鏈限制、CD19 陽性但 CD5 陰性的 B 細胞；組織為單一型小至中型淋巴球瀰漫浸潤，免疫染色核陽性，FISH 出現融合訊號（符合 CCND1::IGH），因此即使 CD5 陰性仍是被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Flow cytometry: kappa-restricted B cells (lambda negative)
Flow cytometry: CD19-positive population lacking CD5 expression
H&E: diffuse sheet of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells with scattered pink hyalinized vessels/histiocytes
IHC inset: one stain negative in tumor cells, the other with strong nuclear positivity in most tumor cells (consistent with cyclin D1)
Interphase FISH dual-color dual-fusion probe showing two fusion signals plus one red and one green signal, indicating a balanced translocation
61055.describe_en: Composite figure. Flow cytometry demonstrates a monotypic kappa-restricted CD19-positive B-cell population that is CD5-negative. Sections of the breast mass show a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells; immunohistochemistry shows strong nuclear positivity in the majority of tumor cells with a companion stain that is negative. Interphase FISH shows a 2 fusion/1 red/1 green pattern consistent with IGH::CCND1 t(11;14). Findings are consistent with CD5-negative mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MZL is CD5-negative but cyclin D1/SOX11-negative and lacks t(11;14).
FL expresses CD10 and BCL6 and carries IGH::BCL2 rather than IGH::CCND1.
Myeloma can be cyclin D1+ with t(11;14) but is CD19/CD20-negative, CD138-positive with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction.

60991.recognize_zh: 同一病人兩種腫瘤：骨髓切片為細胞核間距寬、呈「煎蛋樣」的毛細胞浸潤（抹片插圖有毛狀突起、流式 CD25+/CD103+），BRAF V600E 焦磷酸定序陽性；PET 箭頭處病灶切片則為含多核巨細胞的組織球增生，IHC 呈膜狀陽性（插圖咖啡豆狀核的 Langerhans 細胞），即毛細胞白血病合併 Langerhans 細胞組織球增生症。
features: Panel A: marrow core diffusely infiltrated by small-to-medium cells with round/oval nuclei spaced apart by clear cytoplasm (fried-egg pattern); inset smear shows a lymphoid cell with circumferential hairy projections; inset IHC strongly positive
Panel B: flow cytometry with a red-gated B-cell population coexpressing CD25 and CD103 (with CD19/CD20)
Panel C: pyrosequencing trace at codon 600 (GTG>GAG, Val>Glu) indicating BRAF V600E
Panel D: PET-CT with a focal FDG-avid lesion (red arrow) in the right pelvis/inguinal region and splenomegaly
Panel E: lesional tissue with sheets of histiocytoid cells with grooved/folded nuclei, eosinophils and a multinucleated giant cell (green arrow)
Panels F-I: IHC showing diffuse nuclear/cytoplasmic positivity (F, G), membranous-cytoplasmic positivity with inset showing a grooved Langerhans cell (H), and a largely negative stain (I)
60991.describe_en: This composite figure documents two histiocytic/lymphoid neoplasms in one patient. The bone marrow biopsy shows an interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate of small cells with evenly spaced oval nuclei and clear cytoplasm, with a hairy lymphoid cell on the smear and strong immunohistochemical positivity; flow cytometry identifies a CD25+/CD103+ B-cell population and pyrosequencing detects BRAF V600E, consistent with hairy cell leukemia. A separate FDG-avid lesion contains sheets of histiocytoid cells with grooved nuclei, admixed eosinophils and multinucleated giant cells, with membranous staining in the lesional cells (antibodies not labeled in the figure; typically CD1a/langerin and S100). Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia and a concurrent Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: HCL-v lacks CD25 and annexin A1 and is BRAF V600E wild-type, whereas this clone is CD25-positive with BRAF V600E.
Villous lymphocytes have polar short projections, are usually CD25/CD103-negative and lack BRAF V600E.
Also BRAF-mutated histiocytosis, but lesional foamy histiocytes with Touton cells are CD68/CD163-positive and CD1a/langerin-negative.
Macrophages lack grooved nuclei and are CD1a- and langerin-negative, without the clonal LCH phenotype.

60991.stain: H&E; Wright-Giemsa; IHC; flow; BRAF pyrosequencing; PET

60863.recognize_zh: CD30 染色僅標示散在或小群的較大細胞（膜與高爾基區點狀陽性，反應性免疫母細胞），周圍大量小淋巴細胞為陰性；這些陽性細胞未成片，不應誤判為 CD30 陽性淋巴瘤。
features: Scattered and loosely clustered large cells with membranous and paranuclear dot-like CD30 staining
Positive cells are larger than background lymphocytes, consistent with activated immunoblasts
Background of numerous small CD30-negative lymphoid cells
No confluent sheets of CD30-positive cells; dermal collagen at lower left
60863.describe_en: CD30 immunostain highlights scattered and small clusters of large cells with membranous and Golgi-type staining, consistent with reactive activated immunoblasts. These cells are admixed with a dense background of small CD30-negative lymphoid cells that constitute the bulk of the B-cell infiltrate. There are no sheets of CD30-positive large atypical cells. Findings are consistent with reactive immunoblasts within a cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma and do not indicate a CD30-positive lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: C-ALCL shows sheets (>75%) of large pleomorphic CD30-positive cells, not scattered immunoblasts in a small-cell background.
LyP has scattered large atypical CD30-positive T cells in a wedge-shaped inflammatory infiltrate with neutrophils/eosinophils and a waxing-waning clinical course, rather than a B-cell nodule.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD15 positive, PAX5 weak and CD45 negative, whereas reactive immunoblasts are CD45 positive with strong B- or T-cell markers.

60799.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型非造血細胞成黏聚團塊（A）或散在分布（B），核偏位、核仁明顯、胞質灰藍，無可見黑色素；切片呈上皮樣細胞片狀取代骨髓（C），免疫染色呈強烈胞質及核陽性（D），支持無色素性黑色素瘤轉移。
features: Panel A: cohesive syncytial-like cluster of large cells with overlapping round to oval nuclei on the aspirate
Panel B: dispersed large cells with eccentric nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, mimicking plasma cells or blasts
No melanin pigment visible in the cytoplasm
Panel C: biopsy with sheets of epithelioid cells with vesicular nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm replacing marrow between fat spaces
Panel D: strong diffuse nuclear and cytoplasmic immunoreactivity (melanocytic marker, likely S100) in tumor cells
60799.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show cohesive clusters (A) and scattered single (B) large non-hematopoietic cells with eccentric round nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm without visible pigment. The core biopsy (C) shows sheets of epithelioid tumor cells with vesicular nuclei replacing normal hematopoiesis. Immunohistochemistry (D) shows strong nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity in the tumor cells; the specific antibody is not labeled. Findings are consistent with metastatic amelanotic melanoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Plasmacytoid single cells can mimic this, but myeloma cells are discohesive, CD138/MUM1 positive with light-chain restriction and negative for S100/SOX10.
Also forms cohesive clusters but is cytokeratin positive and S100/SOX10/Melan-A negative.
Large cohesive-appearing cells can mimic metastasis, but they are CD30 and ALK/CD45 positive and melanocytic-marker negative.
Blasts are discohesive with fine chromatin and express CD34/CD117/MPO rather than melanocytic markers.

60607.recognize_zh: 抹片中的大型細胞胞質充滿粗大紫紅色顆粒，看起來很像前骨髓細胞（APL 樣），但細胞核圓至卵圓、無雙葉核或 Auer 棒束（faggot cells），且 RARA 分離探針中期 FISH 訊號仍融合（無重組），提示 G-CSF 刺激造成的假性 APL。
features: Large cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules, some obscuring the nucleus
No bilobed/sliding-plate nuclei and no Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) identified
Cells cohesive in a cluster with basophilic cytoplasmic rims
Metaphase FISH with RARA break-apart probe (17q21): fused signals on both chromosome 17 homologs, no split
60607.describe_en: The smear shows a cluster of large myeloid cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and abundant cytoplasm filled with coarse azurophilic granules, closely resembling hypergranular promyelocytes. Characteristic features of acute promyelocytic leukemia, such as bilobed nuclei and faggot cells, are not seen. Metaphase FISH with a RARA break-apart probe shows two intact fusion signals without evidence of RARA rearrangement. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia showing G-CSF (filgrastim)-induced hypergranulation that mimics acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: APL shows bilobed nuclei, faggot cells, CD34/HLA-DR negativity and PML::RARA fusion, which is absent here by RARA break-apart FISH.

ddx.dx: Reactive left shift after G-CSF therapy
ddx.vs: G-CSF-induced left shift shows a full spectrum of maturing granulocytes with few blasts rather than a monotonous cluster of abnormal cells.
t(8;21) AML has salmon-colored granules, perinuclear hof, single long Auer rods and RUNX1::RUNX1T1 fusion.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with variant RARA partner
ddx.vs: Variant RARA translocations would still show split signals on the RARA break-apart probe.

60671.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中嗜中性球與單核球的胞質內可見成串排列、深藍紫色的短桿菌／球桿菌（A–D），E 圖可見細胞外一長串菌體，F 圖 Gram 染色呈紅色的革蘭氏陰性桿菌；直接在血液抹片看到被吞噬的細菌代表高菌量菌血症。
features: Neutrophils and a monocyte containing intracytoplasmic chains of small, uniform, dark blue-purple short bacilli/coccobacilli (A-D)
Phagocytes with vacuolated cytoplasm and toxic-appearing nuclei
Long extracellular chain of organisms lying free among red cells (E)
Gram stain (F): numerous pink-red rods consistent with gram-negative bacilli
Background red cells with some crenated/echinocytic forms
60671.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils and monocytes containing intracytoplasmic chains of small, uniform, basophilic short rods to coccobacilli (panels A-D), and a long extracellular chain of the same organisms is present among the red cells (panel E). The phagocytes show cytoplasmic vacuolation. A Gram stain (panel F) demonstrates numerous gram-negative bacilli. Findings indicate high-grade bacteremia visible on the routine blood smear; blood cultures and urgent antimicrobial therapy are warranted.

ddx.vs: Stain precipitate is irregular, lies in a different focal plane, and is not arranged in uniform chains within phagocytic vacuoles.
Döhle bodies are pale blue peripheral patches and toxic granules are fine dark dots, neither forming regular chains of rods.
Morulae are stippled, mulberry-like clusters within a vacuole rather than discrete chains of individual bacilli.
Contamination from a delayed or indwelling line specimen can show extracellular bacteria but rarely prominent phagocytosis; repeat venipuncture smear and cultures help distinguish it.

60735.recognize_zh: 抹片中是大量小型、核深染、細胞質極少的淋巴樣細胞，外觀像淋巴球而非典型漿細胞；但骨髓切片的免疫染色呈瀰漫強陽性（包括核染色，符合 cyclin D1），提示為淋巴漿細胞樣形態的漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Panel A: numerous small round cells with dense dark chromatin and scant cytoplasm, resembling small lymphocytes
Panel A: occasional cells with slightly eccentric nuclei and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm (lymphoplasmacytoid)
Panel B: packed marrow infiltrate with diffuse strong membranous/cytoplasmic IHC positivity (marker unlabeled, likely plasma cell marker)
Panel C: diffuse strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining of the infiltrate with a second marker (unlabeled)
Panel D: nuclear staining in most infiltrating cells (unlabeled; pattern fits cyclin D1)
60735.describe_en: The smear shows numerous small lymphoid-appearing cells with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm; classic plasma cell features such as a prominent perinuclear hof are not evident at this magnification. Bone marrow biopsy immunostains show a diffuse, packed infiltrate with strong membranous/cytoplasmic positivity for two markers and nuclear positivity for a third marker in most tumor cells (markers not labeled in the figure). In context, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with lymphoplasmacytic morphology and cyclin D1 expression, which typically associates with t(11;14); mantle cell lymphoma and lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma must be excluded by CD19/CD20, CD138 and light chain studies.

ddx.vs: Both can be cyclin D1+, but MCL cells are CD20+/CD5+ B cells with surface light chain and lack CD138, whereas myeloma cells are CD138+/CD38 bright, CD19 negative and lack CD5 (though t(11;14) myeloma may be CD20+, a pitfall).
LPL comprises a spectrum of CD20+ B cells plus plasma cells, is cyclin D1 negative and MYD88 L265P mutated, whereas this infiltrate is a monomorphic cyclin D1+ plasma cell population.
CLL cells are CD5+/CD23+/CD20 dim with smudge cells and are cyclin D1 negative.

60543.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中可見中型淋巴樣細胞，核呈腎形或有凹陷、染色質粗塊狀、無明顯核仁，細胞質少而淡藍；此類不典型細胞本身無特異性，需搭配脾腫大與 γδ T 細胞表型才能指向肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells, larger than small mature lymphocytes
Irregular, indented to kidney-shaped nuclei
Coarse, clumped chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale-blue cytoplasm without prominent granules
Background red cells with echinocytes/crenated forms and mild poikilocytosis; scattered platelets
60543.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with scattered crenated forms and mild poikilocytosis, and several circulating atypical lymphoid cells. The atypical cells are medium in size with irregular, indented nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a scant to moderate rim of pale agranular cytoplasm. These features are nonspecific morphologically and require flow cytometry for lineage assignment. In a patient with splenomegaly and a gamma-delta T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells have abundant cytoplasm with distinct azurophilic granules and are usually CD8+ alpha-beta T cells, whereas HSTCL cells are agranular or sparsely granular and gamma-delta, CD4-/CD8-.
Sezary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei and a CD4+ CD7-/CD26- phenotype with skin involvement.
SMZL cells are B cells often with polar villous projections, which flow cytometry distinguishes from gamma-delta T cells.
Reactive lymphocytes show a heterogeneous spectrum with abundant cytoplasm and a polyclonal phenotype.

60479.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 Annexin A1 免疫染色，脂肪細胞間的間質性單核細胞大多呈棕色細胞質／膜性陽性；注意少數最深染的細胞為顆粒球（正常就會表現 Annexin A1），需與腫瘤細胞區分。
features: Diffuse interstitial infiltrate of mononuclear cells with moderate cytoplasmic/membranous annexin A1 positivity
Scattered intensely stained cells, likely granulocytic precursors (internal positive control)
Positive infiltrate spread between adipocytes without nodular aggregates
Negative erythroid islands with blue counterstained round nuclei
Fat-rich marrow background
60479.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for annexin A1 shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of mononuclear cells with moderate cytoplasmic and membranous positivity between adipocytes. Scattered strongly positive cells represent myeloid elements, which normally express annexin A1, while erythroid clusters are negative. Because myeloid cells also stain, interpretation should be correlated with a B-cell marker such as CD20 or PAX5. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: HCL-v is annexin A1 negative, CD25 negative, and BRAF V600E wild-type.
SMZL is annexin A1 negative with nodular/intrasinusoidal marrow infiltration.
Granulocytes are also annexin A1 positive, so double staining or comparison with CD20/PAX5 is needed to confirm that the positive cells are B cells.

60351.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量母細胞，細胞質中等量、灰藍色並散佈細小嗜天青顆粒，核圓或輕微凹陷、染色質細緻並可見核仁，偏向單核球系（monoblast/promonocyte）形態，符合 KMT2A 重排的 AML with t(9;11)。
features: Hypercellular particle with numerous intermediate-to-large blasts
Moderate amounts of gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules; no Auer rods evident
Round to slightly indented or folded nuclei with fine, lacy chromatin and visible nucleoli in many cells
Monocytoid appearance consistent with monoblasts and promonocytes
Few interspersed maturing myeloid cells, erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes
60351.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle composed predominantly of intermediate-to-large blasts. The blasts have moderate amounts of gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules, round to slightly indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and one or more visible nucleoli, imparting a monocytoid appearance. No Auer rods are identified, and residual maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic features; cytochemistry (nonspecific esterase) and flow cytometry are recommended, and the t(9;11)(p22;q23) establishes AML with KMT2A-MLLT3.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia without KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so the distinction rests on cytogenetics/FISH for KMT2A (11q23) rearrangement.
Hypogranular APL has bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei, bundles of Auer rods in some cells, strong MPO, and is HLA-DR/CD34-negative with PML-RARA.
CMML has mature monocytes predominating with blasts plus promonocytes below 20%.
Myeloblasts show coarser granules, Auer rods and maturing neutrophils, with strong MPO but negative nonspecific esterase.

60223.recognize_zh: 紅血球普遍偏小、中央淡染區擴大呈低色素，形狀大小不一並有少數橢圓或鉛筆狀細胞；背景血小板數量明顯偏多，符合缺鐵性貧血合併反應性血小板增多。
features: Microcytic red cells with increased central pallor (hypochromia)
Anisopoikilocytosis with oval and elongated pencil-like forms
Numerous scattered platelets suggesting thrombocytosis; platelets small with normal granulation
No leukocytes in field; image resolution is low, limiting fine detail
60223.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows hypochromic, microcytic red cells with anisopoikilocytosis, including oval and elongated pencil cells. Platelets appear increased in number and are morphologically unremarkable. No leukocytes are present in this field, and the low image resolution limits assessment of inclusions. Findings are consistent with iron deficiency anemia with reactive thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: Microcytosis is more uniform with target cells and basophilic stippling, platelets are not typically increased, and iron studies are normal.
Platelets may be large and clumped with normocytic red cells, and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations are present, whereas iron deficiency must be excluded first.
Red cells are usually normochromic or only mildly hypochromic and ferritin is not low.

60159.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin stain）下，黑色纖維在整個視野形成密集、粗細不一且大量交錯的網絡，呈平行流線狀排列，夾雜被拉長的造血細胞與巨核細胞，符合明顯增加的網狀纖維化（至少MF-2）。
features: Diffuse dense network of black reticulin fibers with extensive intersections
Fibers coarse and thickened, oriented in parallel streaming bundles
Entrapped hematopoietic cells and megakaryocytes aligned along fibers
Focal brown pigment/background deposits, likely hemosiderin or nonspecific staining
Fiber density suggests at least grade MF-2; collagen confirmation requires trichrome stain
60159.describe_en: Reticulin-stained section of bone marrow core biopsy shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and coarse, thickened fibers arranged in streaming parallel bundles. Hematopoietic cells, including megakaryocytes, are entrapped within the fiber network. Collagen deposition cannot be assessed without a trichrome stain. Findings are consistent with marked reticulin fibrosis (at least WHO grade MF-2), compatible with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in context.

ddx.vs: Reticulin pattern is identical, so separation depends on a prior documented diagnosis of polycythemia vera.

ddx.dx: Reactive/secondary fibrosis (metastatic tumor, hairy cell leukemia, renal osteodystrophy)
ddx.vs: Fibrosis surrounds an infiltrating tumor or lymphoid population demonstrable on H&E and IHC rather than atypical megakaryocytic proliferation.
Consists of scattered fine linear fibers mainly around vessels without the dense intersecting coarse network seen here.

60095.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆高核質比、染色質細緻、細胞質極少的芽細胞，旁邊的中性球只有兩葉且染色質粗塊（pseudo-Pelger-Huët 樣），顯示合併顆粒球發育不良；此單一視野無法呈現標題所述的顯著白血球增多。
features: Circulating blast about twice the size of a red cell with a very high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Bilobed neutrophil with clumped chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-Huët-like), suggesting dysgranulopoiesis
Red cells normocytic with mild anisocytosis; platelets not seen in this field
Leukocytosis cannot be assessed from this high-power field
60095.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast with a very high N:C ratio, a round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm, without visible granules or Auer rods. An adjacent neutrophil has a bilobed nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin, a pseudo-Pelger-Huët-like dysplastic feature. Red cells show mild anisocytosis and platelets are not seen in this field. The marked leukocytosis described clinically cannot be appreciated in this single high-power field, but findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic features, in keeping with a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huët affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no circulating blasts.
A single agranular blast cannot be assigned lineage morphologically; flow cytometry (MPO, CD33/CD13 vs lymphoid markers) is required.
Leukemoid reactions show a left shift with myelocytes and toxic granulation but not blasts with dysplastic hyposegmented neutrophils.

30975.recognize_zh: 四格圖：組織中一片卵圓或腎形核、染色質細緻的中型單核細胞（A），周邊血可見具淡藍細胞質、核不規則的單核球樣異常細胞（B），骨髓切片高度細胞化（C），免疫染色見局部陽性細胞群（D）；標題（ad 1）無法指出確切診斷。
features: Panel A: sheets of intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with oval to indented nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Panel B: peripheral blood with three atypical mononuclear cells with irregular/folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm; red cells with rouleaux-free normal distribution and scattered platelets
Panel C: hypercellular bone marrow biopsy with a diffuse population of mononuclear cells and reduced fat
Panel D: immunohistochemistry highlighting a focal cluster of positive cells in a marrow section, most cells negative
Specific antigen in panel D is not labeled in the image
30975.describe_en: Composite figure. Tissue section (A) shows sheets of intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with oval to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm. The peripheral blood smear (B) contains atypical mononuclear cells with irregular nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm, and the bone marrow biopsy (C) is hypercellular with a diffuse mononuclear infiltrate; immunohistochemistry (D) highlights a focal cluster of positive cells, but the antigen is not identified. The title and category (acquired neutropenia) do not specify the diagnosis; the morphology is suggestive of a monocytic/histiocytoid neoplastic infiltrate involving tissue, blood and marrow, and definitive classification requires the immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation / myeloid sarcoma
ddx.vs: Blasts and promonocytes express CD33, CD64, CD14/CD68 and lysozyme and are nonspecific esterase positive.
T-LGL cells are small lymphocytes with round nuclei and azurophilic granules and express CD3, CD8, CD57, which classically cause neutropenia.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic or other peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Tumor cells express T-cell markers (CD3, TCR) and show intrasinusoidal marrow infiltration rather than monocytic markers.
Cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophils in the background and express CD1a, langerin and S100.

28479.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血中嗜中性球明顯增多，幾乎全是分葉成熟的嗜中性球，部分胞質顆粒偏粗，看不到原始細胞、未成熟顆粒球或發育不良，這種單純成熟嗜中性球增多是慢性嗜中性球白血病的表現。
features: Increased numbers of mature segmented neutrophils in a low-power field
Neutrophils with normal nuclear segmentation and some coarse cytoplasmic granulation
Absence of blasts, promyelocytes and myelocytes; no dysgranulopoiesis
No basophilia, eosinophilia or monocytosis
Red cells largely normochromic with occasional target-like cells; platelets present
28479.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophilia composed almost entirely of mature segmented neutrophils with normal nuclear lobation and occasional coarse cytoplasmic granulation. Immature granulocytes, blasts, basophilia and monocytosis are not seen, and dysplastic features are absent. Red cells are largely unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a mature neutrophilia, which in the absence of a reactive cause, BCR::ABL1 and a plasma cell neoplasm, and with a CSF3R mutation, supports chronic neutrophilic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive neutrophilia looks morphologically identical, so persistence, exclusion of infection/inflammation and clonality (CSF3R) are needed.
aCML shows marked dysgranulopoiesis and ≥10% immature granulocytes, which are absent here.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia (including p230 neutrophilic variant)
ddx.vs: The e19a2 p230 BCR::ABL1 variant can mimic CNL with mature neutrophilia, so BCR::ABL1 testing is mandatory.

ddx.dx: Polycythemia vera or primary myelofibrosis with neutrophilia
ddx.vs: These MPNs show erythrocytosis or leukoerythroblastosis with teardrop cells and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.

1983.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血細胞稀少、間質水腫，血竇與間質內塞滿大量細長彎曲的鐮刀型紅血球團塊；箭頭指向一顆核深染的紅系細胞，整體紅系前驅細胞很少，符合鐮刀型貧血患者再生不良危象時的骨髓。
features: Hypocellular marrow with fat spaces and edematous, loose stroma
Sinusoids and interstitium packed with aggregates of elongated, crescentic sickled red cells
Scattered mononuclear cells, histiocytes and stromal cells with few hematopoietic precursors
Arrow highlights a single small cell with a dense round dark nucleus (erythroid precursor); intranuclear viral inclusions are not discernible
No maturing erythroid islands identified
1983.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypocellular, edematous marrow with scattered stromal cells, histiocytes and lymphoid cells, and very few maturing hematopoietic precursors. Numerous vascular spaces and interstitial areas are filled with aggregates of elongated, sickled red cells, reflecting in vivo sickling and vaso-occlusion. An isolated erythroid cell with a dense nucleus is indicated, but erythroid islands are not seen, and viral inclusions cannot be confirmed at this magnification. In a patient with sickle cell disease, findings are consistent with aplastic crisis with marrow sickling; parvovirus B19 immunohistochemistry or PCR is recommended.

ddx.dx: Bone marrow necrosis in sickle cell crisis
ddx.vs: Marrow necrosis shows ghost cells with eosinophilic amorphous debris and loss of nuclear detail, rather than viable stroma with depleted precursors.
Aplastic anemia affects all lineages with fatty replacement and lacks the transient pure erythroid arrest of B19 infection.

ddx.dx: Post-mortem or ex vivo sickling artifact
ddx.vs: Sickling can occur in hypoxic specimens, so erythroid depletion and clinical reticulocytopenia are needed to support aplastic crisis.

15167.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD20 免疫染色，棕色陽性的 B 細胞在骨小樑之間呈瀰漫性間質（interstitial）浸潤，散布於脂肪細胞之間，而非形成結節，這種分布方式是毛細胞白血病侵犯骨髓的特徵。
features: Diffuse interstitial infiltrate of CD20-positive (brown membranous) cells throughout the intertrabecular space
Positive cells distributed singly and in sheets between fat cells, without discrete nodules
Denser confluent areas at the left edge of the marrow space
Residual fat cells and bony trabeculae (blue-gray) preserved
Low-power view; individual cell cytology not assessable
15167.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for CD20 shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of CD20-positive B cells filling the intertrabecular space and percolating between fat cells, with denser confluent areas at one edge and no well-formed lymphoid nodules. Bony trabeculae are intact. At this magnification cytologic detail cannot be assessed, but the extent of involvement is readily appreciated and would be underestimated on H&E. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia; confirmatory stains include annexin A1, TRAP, cyclin D1 (weak) and BRAF V600E (VE1).

ddx.vs: SMZL typically forms nodular and intrasinusoidal CD20+ infiltrates rather than a diffuse interstitial pattern and is annexin A1- and BRAF V600E-negative.
CLL infiltrates are nodular, interstitial or diffuse with dim CD20 and co-express CD5 and CD23/LEF1, which hairy cells lack.
HCL-v can infiltrate interstitially and intrasinusoidally but is annexin A1-, CD25-, TRAP-weak/negative and BRAF wild-type.
Reactive B cells form small scattered aggregates with a mix of T cells and do not diffusely replace the marrow.

13503.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下骨髓基質為流線狀排列的纖維與紡錘狀細胞，中央有一個核深染、呈雲朵狀或摺疊不規則的異常巨核細胞（atypical megakaryocyte），左上方擴張竇內含有核造血細胞；纖維化加上異型巨核細胞，符合原發性骨髓纖維化纖維化期。
features: Streaming fibrous stroma with parallel collagen fibers and elongated spindle nuclei
Atypical megakaryocyte with hyperchromatic, irregularly folded, cloud-like nucleus in the center
Second megakaryocyte-like cell with lobulated nucleus in amphophilic cytoplasm at left
Dilated sinusoidal spaces containing small nucleated hematopoietic cells and red cells (intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis)
Edge of thickened bone trabecula at right; scattered fat vacuoles
13503.describe_en: High-power H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows streaming fibrous stroma with spindle-shaped nuclei. Within it lie atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregularly folded, cloud-like nuclei, and nearby dilated sinusoids contain small nucleated hematopoietic cells consistent with intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis. An adjacent bony trabecula is present. Findings are consistent with the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis; reticulin and trichrome staining for fibrosis grading and driver mutation analysis are recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated or micromegakaryocytes, not large cells with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei.
APMF shows increased CD34-positive blasts (at least 20%) with small dysplastic megakaryocytes and an acute presentation without marked splenomegaly.
Reactive fibrosis usually has normal-appearing megakaryocytes and lacks JAK2, CALR or MPL mutations.

3455.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆邊界不清的大型組織球，胞質淡灰藍並散布藍綠色顆粒與數個圓形黑色小球狀碎屑，周圍為顆粒球前驅細胞，符合吞噬碎屑的組織球（debris-laden histiocyte）。
features: Large histiocyte with ill-defined borders and abundant pale, vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm
Numerous cytoplasmic blue-green granules and several discrete round black globules (phagocytosed debris, possible pigment or apoptotic fragments)
Histiocyte nucleus oval with fine chromatin, partly overlapped by adjacent cells
Surrounding myelocytes, a promyelocyte-like granular cell and small erythroid precursors
3455.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm containing numerous blue-green granules and several round black globular inclusions, surrounded by maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. No intact phagocytosed red cells or nucleated cells are clearly identified within the histiocyte, and no organisms are seen. The blue-green granules may represent ceroid or hemosiderin, which could be clarified with an iron stain. Findings are consistent with a debris-laden histiocyte, a nonspecific finding associated with increased marrow cell turnover.

ddx.vs: Sea-blue histiocytes are filled with uniform, more deeply blue ceroid granules rather than scattered granules mixed with heterogeneous black debris.
Hemophagocytes show recognizable ingested erythrocytes, platelets or nucleated cells.
Hemosiderin granules would stain intensely blue on Prussian blue, which is needed to confirm iron content.

4927.recognize_zh: 中下方一顆嗜中性球的細胞質內含一大團均質、淡紫色、無染色質結構的圓形包涵體（被吞噬的變性細胞核），把自身分葉核擠到邊緣形成新月狀，這就是 LE 細胞；背景可見灰色蛋白質沉積。
features: Neutrophil containing a large, round, homogeneous, glassy pale purple inclusion (hematoxylin body) lacking chromatin structure
Neutrophil nucleus compressed and displaced to the periphery as a crescent
Surrounding granulocytes including myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils with normal nuclear detail
Smudgy gray proteinaceous background material
No bacteria or fungal organisms identified
4927.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic cells in a gray proteinaceous background. One neutrophil contains a large round homogeneous, structureless pale purple inclusion that displaces its own nucleus into a peripheral crescent. This represents phagocytosis of antibody-opsonized, denatured nuclear material. Findings are consistent with an LE cell, which suggests the presence of antinuclear antibodies (e.g., systemic lupus erythematosus or drug-induced lupus); serologic testing (ANA, anti-dsDNA, anti-histone) is recommended.

ddx.vs: In a tart cell the ingested nucleus retains chromatin pattern and is usually engulfed by a monocyte/macrophage, whereas the LE body is homogeneous and inside a neutrophil.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with phagocytosed nRBC or apoptotic cell
ddx.vs: An engulfed intact cell shows condensed chromatin or a rim of cytoplasm, unlike the smooth glassy hematoxylin body.
Ring or giant forms have no intracytoplasmic inclusion and show normal nuclear chromatin throughout.
Chédiak-Higashi inclusions are multiple, discrete, peroxidase-positive granules rather than one large homogeneous nuclear mass.

1791.recognize_zh: 高倍（油鏡）下箭頭所指的大型細胞，細胞質呈洋紅色並帶有細長交錯、像「皺摺薄紙」般的條紋，細胞核被推向一側，符合高雪細胞；影像略失焦，細節判讀有限。
features: Large histiocyte (arrow) with abundant cytoplasm and an eccentric, peripherally displaced nucleus
Intensely magenta cytoplasm with linear, wavy striations (crumpled tissue paper texture)
Surrounding smaller mononuclear cells and erythroid-type cells
Cytoplasmic color suggests PAS positivity
Image is out of focus, limiting nuclear detail
1791.describe_en: High-power view of a tissue section (probably bone marrow; stain appears to be PAS) shows a large histiocyte (arrow) with abundant magenta cytoplasm containing fine linear, wavy striations and an eccentric nucleus, among smaller surrounding cells. The image is somewhat out of focus, limiting assessment of nuclear detail. The striated, PAS-positive cytoplasm is characteristic of a Gaucher cell, consistent with Gaucher disease.

ddx.vs: They share striated PAS-positive cytoplasm; normal glucocerebrosidase activity and the underlying disease separate them.
Megakaryocytes have a large lobulated central nucleus and granular rather than linearly striated cytoplasm.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm without striations and weaker PAS staining.

1407.recognize_zh: 這是血小板凝集試驗曲線圖而非形態圖：以 ADP（A）及花生四烯酸（B）刺激時，藍色曲線（Channel 1）的最大凝集率明顯低於洋紅色曲線（Channel 3），提示血小板功能受抑制，可見於骨髓瘤副蛋白干擾。
features: Light transmission aggregometry tracings, percent aggregation versus time (min:sec)
Panel A (ADP): Channel 1 (blue) plateaus near 20% aggregation, while Channel 3 (magenta) reaches about 68%
Panel B (arachidonic acid): Channel 1 (blue) reaches about 55% with a slow slope, while Channel 3 (magenta) reaches about 65%
Channel 4 (light blue) is a secondary tracing on the right axis, likely ATP release
Low image resolution; channel assignment (patient vs control) is not labeled in the figure
1407.describe_en: Light transmission platelet aggregometry is shown with ADP (panel A) and arachidonic acid (panel B) as agonists. With ADP, the Channel 1 tracing shows markedly reduced maximal aggregation (about 20%) compared with Channel 3 (about 68%). With arachidonic acid, Channel 1 shows a slower and lower aggregation response (about 55%) compared with Channel 3 (about 65%). If Channel 1 represents the patient and Channel 3 the normal control, the pattern indicates impaired platelet aggregation, which in multiple myeloma can result from paraprotein coating of platelet membranes. The channel legend is not explicitly labeled, so interpretation depends on the accompanying clinical context.

ddx.vs: Aspirin causes an absent arachidonic acid response with a preserved primary ADP wave, whereas this tracing shows the largest defect with ADP.
Morphology cannot help; drug history is needed, as clopidogrel selectively reduces ADP aggregation just like this pattern.
Glanzmann shows absent aggregation to all agonists except ristocetin, rather than a partial reduction.
AVWS primarily reduces ristocetin-induced aggregation and VWF activity, which requires VWF assays rather than ADP/AA tracings.

1279.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸液的顆粒（particle）中聚集許多小型、核單葉或低分葉的巨核細胞（hypolobated micromegakaryocytes），周圍還有不少母細胞；AML 合併巨核細胞增生且型態異常，應聯想 inv(3)/t(3;3)（MECOM）。
features: Marrow particle containing numerous megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or minimally lobated nuclei (hypolobated/monolobated forms)
Megakaryocytes vary from small to intermediate size with abundant granular cytoplasm and platelet budding into the particle
Background of scattered intermediate-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Admixed maturing granulocytes and small lymphocytes around the particle
Cellular particle; no specific dysplastic granulocyte features resolvable at this magnification
1279.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle densely populated by megakaryocytes. Many megakaryocytes are small to intermediate in size with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei, indicating dysmegakaryopoiesis. The surrounding cells include an increased population of blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, together with residual maturing granulocytes. In the setting of acute myeloid leukemia, these findings are suggestive of AML with inv(3)(q21.3q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21.3;q26.2) (GATA2::MECOM); confirmation requires cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: del(5q) shows small monolobated megakaryocytes too, but blasts are <5% and platelets are typically normal to increased with macrocytic anemia, whereas here blasts are clearly increased.
AMKL is dominated by megakaryoblasts with cytoplasmic blebs rather than many mature-appearing hypolobated megakaryocytes, and lacks MECOM rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis / MPN with megakaryocytic proliferation
ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are large and hyperlobated or cloud-like with dense clusters on biopsy and no blast increase, rather than small hypolobated forms with excess blasts.

1215.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見三顆小到中型成熟淋巴球，核圓、染色質塊狀，其中右上那顆細胞膜周圍有短而不規則的細胞質突起（villous projections），符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤白血病期的絨毛狀淋巴球；其他兩顆特徵較不明顯。
features: Small to medium-sized mature-appearing lymphocytes, slightly larger than a red cell
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Round nuclei with clumped (condensed) chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous
Short, fine, irregular cytoplasmic projections in one cell (upper right), polar/uneven distribution
No smudge cells in this field; background red cells largely normocytic with normal platelets
1215.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and a narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm. One lymphocyte shows short, irregular, fine cytoplasmic projections along part of its border, consistent with a villous lymphocyte; the villous change is subtle in the other two cells. Red cells and platelets show no specific abnormality in this field. In the setting of splenomegaly and a clonal CD20+ B-cell population lacking CD5, CD10, CD103 and annexin A1, findings are consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in leukemic phase.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells are larger with abundant pale cytoplasm, circumferential hair-like projections and oval/bean-shaped nuclei with softer chromatin, and are CD103+/CD25+/CD11c+/annexin A1+.
CLL cells are small round lymphocytes without villi, accompanied by smudge cells, and co-express CD5 and CD23.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: Variant cells have a prominent central nucleolus and more abundant cytoplasm, with CD103+ but CD25-negative phenotype.
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm rather than polar villi, with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

1087.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑之間充滿密集的造血細胞，脂肪幾乎消失並伴隨出血；只能看出高細胞密度，無法單憑此圖判定 CML 的細胞組成。
features: Low-power bone marrow biopsy with bony trabeculae
Markedly hypercellular intertrabecular spaces with near absence of fat
Dense sheets of small hematopoietic cells with areas of streaming
Extensive hemorrhage/artifactual blood between marrow fragments
Cellular detail (megakaryocyte morphology, blasts) not resolvable at this magnification
1087.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow biopsy shows bony trabeculae with markedly hypercellular marrow spaces and near-complete loss of fat, admixed with abundant hemorrhage. Focal cellular streaming suggests crush or fibrosis. Individual cell lineages and megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. Hypercellularity is compatible with the clinical diagnosis of chronic myeloid leukemia, but the image alone is not specific.

ddx.dx: Other myeloproliferative neoplasms (primary myelofibrosis, polycythemia vera)
ddx.vs: These show clustered, atypical megakaryocytes and are BCR::ABL1 negative; high-power review and molecular testing are needed.
Acute leukemia shows sheets of blasts rather than maturing granulopoiesis at high power and ≥20% blasts on aspirate.
Reactive marrow retains normal maturation and megakaryocytes and lacks BCR::ABL1; clinical context and cytogenetics distinguish it.

4223.recognize_zh: 尿沉渣做鐵染色（Perls/Prussian blue）：背景有多團藍黑色含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin）顆粒，旁邊為粉紅色複染的鱗狀上皮細胞；尿中出現含鐵血黃素代表慢性血管內溶血，符合長期 PNH。
features: Clusters and scattered granules of dark blue Prussian blue-positive material (hemosiderin) in the urine sediment
Hemosiderin granules are coarse, mostly extracellular or within cellular debris in this field
Several large polygonal squamous epithelial cells with small central nuclei, counterstained pink and negative for iron
No intact renal tubular epithelial cells clearly identified in this field
4223.describe_en: Urine sediment cytospin stained with Perls Prussian blue shows multiple coarse blue-black iron-positive granules and clusters in the background, consistent with hemosiderinuria. Several large squamous epithelial cells with pink counterstain are iron negative, and the positive granules are largely extracellular or associated with debris rather than clearly within renal tubular cells in this field. Findings are consistent with hemosiderinuria, supporting chronic intravascular hemolysis in this patient with known paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria.

ddx.vs: Acute hemolysis produces free hemoglobin (dipstick positive, red urine) but hemosiderin granules require several days of tubular iron handling and are Prussian blue positive only in chronic or subacute hemolysis.
Hematuria shows intact red cells in the sediment, whereas hemosiderinuria shows iron-positive granules without red cells.
Precipitate and bacteria are not specifically Prussian blue positive and appear as uniform small particles or rods rather than coarse refractile blue iron granules.

1023.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中散布大量破碎、呈模糊紫色網狀的污跡細胞（smudge cells），加上許多核圓、染色質濃密、細胞質極少的成熟小淋巴球，是慢性淋巴球白血病（CLL）的典型表現。
features: Numerous smudge cells: disrupted lymphocytes with smeared, lacy nuclear chromatin and no intact cytoplasm
Increased small mature lymphocytes, about the size of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with scant rim of cytoplasm
Round nuclei with dense, clumped chromatin; nucleoli not seen
Red cells show mild polychromasia and scattered target-like forms
1023.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an absolute lymphocytosis of small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells. No prolymphocytes or blasts are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry demonstrating a clonal CD5+/CD23+/CD200+ B-cell population with dim surface light chain is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: MCL cells often have irregular nuclear contours, are CD23-negative/CD200-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with t(11;14).
Reactive lymphocytes are larger and heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm and are polyclonal; smudge cells are much less numerous.
SMZL cells show polar villous projections and are typically CD5-negative and CD23-negative.

4095.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現三顆漿細胞：核偏心、染色質粗塊、細胞質藍色並有核旁淡染區；背景紅血球呈疊錢狀（rouleaux）排列，提示漿細胞白血病或骨髓瘤白血病期。
features: Three circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and coarse clumped chromatin
Moderate amount of basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
One small mature lymphocyte for size comparison (upper field)
Red cells stacked in short chains consistent with rouleaux formation
No blasts or nucleated red cells in field
4095.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, perinuclear hofs, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, along with a small mature lymphocyte. The background red cells display rouleaux formation, reflecting elevated serum paraprotein. Circulating clonal plasma cells at a frequency of at least 5% of leukocytes define plasma cell leukemia in current criteria. Findings are consistent with the leukemic phase of plasma cell myeloma (plasma cell leukemia); a manual differential and flow cytometric quantitation of clonal plasma cells are recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive circulating plasma cells (e.g., viral infection, sepsis)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasmacytosis in blood is transient, polytypic, and usually lacks rouleaux and marrow myeloma.
Reactive lymphocytes have central nuclei with cytoplasm hugging adjacent red cells and lack a perinuclear hof.
Shows a continuum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with CD19/CD20 expression and IgM paraprotein.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: Cells are villous lymphocytes with polar cytoplasmic projections and CD20 positivity rather than hof-bearing plasma cells.

4031.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量高，有大型、核分葉增多的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）零散或成群分布，並有大量核圓深染的紅血球系前驅細胞；巨核細胞類似 ET/PMF 的增生合併紅血球系增生，符合伴環狀鐵粒母細胞與血小板增多之 MDS/MPN。
features: Hypercellular marrow with near-complete replacement of fat
Large megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated, staghorn-like nuclei, some loosely clustered (upper left)
Numerous erythroid precursors with round, dark, condensed nuclei and perinuclear halos
Granulocytic precursors with indented nuclei admixed
No sheets of blasts identified; mild edematous stroma
4031.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are increased and enlarged with hyperlobulated nuclei and form loose clusters, resembling those of essential thrombocythemia or primary myelofibrosis. Erythroid precursors are prominent, and granulocytic maturation is present without an obvious increase in blasts. In conjunction with thrombocytosis and ring sideroblasts on iron stain, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes look similar, but ET lacks erythroid hyperplasia with anemia and has fewer than 15% ring sideroblasts.
PMF megakaryocytes are more atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei and dense clustering, with granulocytic rather than erythroid predominance.
MDS-RS lacks the large hyperlobulated megakaryocyte proliferation and thrombocytosis; SF3B1 mutation is shared, so JAK2 or MPL co-mutation and platelet count help separate them.

3903.recognize_zh: 同一視野中有細胞核偏心、細胞質豐富藍色並帶核周淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞，也有細胞核圓而置中、染色質致密、細胞質少的晚期紅血球前驅細胞，是練習區分兩者的外觀相似對照圖。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, abundant blue cytoplasm and paranuclear hof
Late erythroid precursors with central round nuclei, dense condensed chromatin and a thin rim of polychromatic cytoplasm
Plasma cell chromatin coarse but less dense than orthochromatic normoblasts
Scattered granulocytic precursors and segmented neutrophils
Background red cells with drying artifact
3903.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear contains a mixture of plasma cells and erythroid precursors, which can be confused at lower power. Plasma cells show eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof, whereas polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts have centrally placed, round, very dense nuclei with a narrow rim of grey-pink to blue cytoplasm and no hof. Granulocytic precursors and neutrophils are also present. This field illustrates the morphologic discrimination between plasma cells and late erythroid precursors.

ddx.vs: Basophilic normoblasts have a central nucleus with deep blue cytoplasm lacking a hof and often a perinuclear pale zone around the whole nucleus, while plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus and a localized Golgi hof.
Lymphocytes have scant cytoplasm surrounding a central nucleus without a hof, whereas plasma cells have abundant eccentric cytoplasm.
Osteoblasts are larger with a hof located away from the nucleus and occur in clusters, whereas plasma cells have a hof adjacent to the nucleus.

3967.recognize_zh: 同一視野可同時看到三種線索：箭頭指的鈍端、有稜角的 HbSC 結晶，雙箭頭指的靶形紅血球，以及箭形標記處細長尖端的鐮刀型紅血球，另外還有許多摺疊、濃縮的紅血球，符合 HbSC 疾病。
features: Red cell with dense, blunt, angular hemoglobin crystal protrusions (arrow)
Numerous target cells (double arrow)
Occasional elongated sickle cell (arrowheads)
Many folded, irregularly contracted and dense red cells
Adequate platelets; a polychromatic cell present
3967.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells (double arrow), many folded and irregularly contracted dense red cells, and cells containing blunt, straight-edged hemoglobin crystals (arrow). An occasional elongated sickle cell is present (arrowheads), and a polychromatic red cell is seen. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin SC disease, to be confirmed by hemoglobin HPLC or electrophoresis.

ddx.vs: HbSS has many thin, pointed sickle cells and fewer target cells, and lacks blunt SC crystals.
HbCC shows target cells with rhomboid/hexagonal HbC crystals but no sickle cells.
HbS/beta-thalassemia shows microcytic hypochromic cells with sickle and target cells, and HPLC shows HbS with elevated HbA2 and no HbC.

3839.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量高，間質可見散在核偏位的漿細胞、數個巨核細胞與少量含鐵血黃素；在此倍率漿細胞增加不算顯眼，需搭配 CD138 染色才能準確評估漿細胞增多。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis
Scattered interstitial plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm, not forming sheets
Numerous megakaryocytes, some large with hyperlobated nuclei
Focal golden-brown hemosiderin pigment in macrophages
No discrete infiltrate or fibrosis evident at this magnification
3839.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and numerous megakaryocytes. Scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm are present interstitially, but they do not form clusters or sheets and are difficult to quantify at this magnification. Focal hemosiderin-laden macrophages are noted. The findings are compatible with a reactive marrow with interstitial plasmacytosis in the setting of HIV infection; CD138 and kappa/lambda immunostains are needed to quantify plasma cells and confirm polytypism.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows clustered or sheet-like plasma cells with light-chain restriction rather than scattered polytypic interstitial plasma cells.
MPNs show clustered, atypical megakaryocytes with driver mutations (JAK2/CALR/MPL), whereas megakaryocytes here are dispersed within a reactive background.
HIV myelopathy may show dysplasia but lacks recurrent MDS cytogenetic abnormalities and blasts are not increased.

3775.recognize_zh: 這是免疫組化染色：許多中至大型細胞呈棕色細胞膜陽性，散布在大量陰性小淋巴球之間；圖上未標示抗體，需對照 CD20／CD3 等染色判讀 T 細胞／組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤中大細胞與背景細胞的免疫表型。
features: Immunohistochemical stain with crisp brown membranous (ring-like) staining
Positive cells are numerous, dispersed singly and in small groups, and are intermediate to large with pale nuclei
Background of many negative small round lymphoid nuclei counterstained blue
No sheets of positive large cells
Specific antibody not indicated in the image
3775.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a lymph node section shows membranous staining of numerous dispersed intermediate-to-large cells, set against a background of negative small lymphocytes. The positive cells are distributed singly and in small loose groups without forming sheets. Because the antibody is not labeled, the precise interpretation is limited: in T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma, CD20 or PAX5 would highlight the scattered large neoplastic B cells, whereas CD3 would highlight the predominant background T cells. Findings should be interpreted together with the H&E and the full immunohistochemical panel.

ddx.vs: In NLPHL, CD20 highlights nodules of small background B cells with CD21+ FDC meshworks, and PD-1+ T cells rosette the LP cells.
HRS cells are CD30+ and CD15+ with CD20 negative or weak and heterogeneous, unlike uniformly CD20+ large B cells.
In PTCL the atypical intermediate-to-large cells themselves are CD3+ and CD20-, often with aberrant loss of pan-T antigens.

3199.recognize_zh: 高倍下大型組織球的細胞核與細胞質均呈強棕色陽性（S100 典型的核加質染色），細胞質中有完整的藍色淋巴球位於透亮空隙內，清楚呈現 emperipolesis，是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的經典免疫染色影像。
features: Large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic brown staining (S100-type pattern)
Intact unstained lymphocytes and plasma cells within histiocyte cytoplasm, some in clear halos (emperipolesis)
Histiocyte nuclei round and vesicular where visible
Background small lymphocytes and endothelial cells negative
No cytologic atypia in the positive cells
3199.describe_en: High-power immunohistochemical stain shows large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity. Within their cytoplasm are intact, unstained lymphocytes and plasma cells, several lying within clear halos, demonstrating emperipolesis. The surrounding small lymphocytes are negative, and the positive cells show no significant atypia. The nuclear-plus-cytoplasmic pattern is characteristic of S100, although the antibody is not labeled. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease; CD1a negativity and OCT2 or cyclin D1 positivity further support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: LCH is S100 positive but CD1a and langerin positive, with grooved nuclei and eosinophils, and lacks emperipolesis.
HLH macrophages phagocytose and digest red cells, platelets and nucleated cells and are S100 negative.
ECD histiocytes are foamy, S100 negative or weak, CD1a negative and typically harbor BRAF V600E with sclerosing bone lesions.

3327.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色低倍率下，大量細胞呈強烈細胞膜陽性，以間質性到大片狀分布於脂肪空泡之間，殘存造血細胞為陰性；最可能是 CD20 等 B 細胞標記，顯示毛細胞白血病變異型的廣泛骨髓侵犯。
features: Bone marrow core at low power with diffuse interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate
Strong, crisp membranous brown staining of numerous small to intermediate cells
Positive cells separated by clear membrane outlines giving a honeycomb pattern
Interspersed negative residual hematopoietic cells and fat spaces
No nodular or paratrabecular aggregates evident in this field
3327.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow biopsy shows an extensive interstitial to diffuse infiltrate of small to intermediate cells with strong membranous positivity, arranged between fat spaces and residual negative hematopoietic elements. The positive cells are well spaced with crisp membranous outlines, and there is no distinct nodular or paratrabecular pattern in this field. The antibody is not labeled; the pattern is most consistent with a pan-B-cell marker such as CD20. Findings indicate extensive marrow involvement by a B-cell neoplasm, consistent with hairy cell leukemia variant in context; annexin A1, CD25 and BRAF V600E studies separate it from classic HCL.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL has the same interstitial CD20+ pattern but is annexin A1+, CD25+, cyclin D1 weak+ and BRAF V600E+, which HCL-v lacks.
SMZL usually forms nodular and intrasinusoidal infiltrates rather than a diffuse interstitial pattern.
CLL cells coexpress CD5 and CD23/LEF1 and often form nodules with proliferation centers.

3327.stain: IHC: B-cell marker, presumed CD20 (not labeled)

3135.recognize_zh: 背景有大量標靶細胞（target cells），並散見數個深染、呈棒狀或六角形的血紅素C結晶（HbC crystals），是同型合子血紅素C症的典型抹片。
features: Numerous target cells among normocytic red cells
Several dense, dark-staining rod-shaped to hexagonal HbC crystals, some lying free or in nearly empty red cell ghosts
Occasional folded cells and small dense spherocytic cells
Mild anisopoikilocytosis
Scattered platelets; granulocyte partly obscured by the watermark
3135.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows many target cells with occasional folded and small dense cells. Several red cells contain or are replaced by dense, dark-staining rod-shaped to hexagonal crystals with straight parallel edges. No sickle cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with homozygous hemoglobin C disease.

ddx.vs: HbSC crystals are blunt, irregular, finger-like projections (Washington Monument or mitten shapes) and are accompanied by occasional sickle forms.
Target cells in liver disease are macrocytic and lack intracellular HbC crystals.
Thalassemia shows microcytic target cells and basophilic stippling without crystals, and hemoglobin electrophoresis lacks an HbC band.

3007.recognize_zh: 高倍下大量核深染、形狀不規則的小淋巴球浸入表皮下半部，許多細胞周圍有透明暈並成群聚集在表皮內小空腔中，旁邊角質細胞核淡而有核仁，形成 Pautrier 樣聚集，符合蕈狀肉芽腫。
features: Numerous small lymphocytes with dark, irregular to convoluted nuclei within the lower epidermis
Perinuclear clear halos around many intraepidermal lymphocytes
Small clusters of lymphocytes within intraepidermal spaces (Pautrier-like collections)
Minimal spongiosis despite heavy lymphocyte infiltration
Keratinocytes with larger pale nuclei and nucleoli; dense lymphoid infiltrate at the dermal-epidermal junction
3007.describe_en: High-power view shows heavy infiltration of the lower epidermis and dermal-epidermal junction by small lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular to convoluted nuclei. Many of the intraepidermal lymphocytes lie within clear halos, and several form small clusters within intraepidermal spaces reminiscent of Pautrier microabscesses. Spongiosis is minimal, and adjacent keratinocytes have pale vesicular nuclei. Findings are consistent with the pronounced epidermotropism of mycosis fungoides.

ddx.vs: Reactive exocytosis occurs with marked spongiosis and non-atypical lymphocytes lacking halos, unlike this haloed atypical infiltrate without spongiosis.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: This entity has pagetoid epidermotropism with keratinocyte necrosis and ulceration, rapid clinical course, and a CD8+ cytotoxic phenotype.
Skin histology can be identical; Sezary syndrome is defined by erythroderma, lymphadenopathy, and clonal circulating Sezary cells.

2815.recognize_zh: 大量顆粒球系細胞呈連續成熟譜系，骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀及分葉核中性球都有，並夾雜數顆較大、染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性的早期細胞；左移明顯，需計數母細胞才能分期。
features: Numerous granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei and gray-pink granular cytoplasm
Several larger immature cells (promyelocytes/blasts) with finer chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Bands and segmented neutrophils without obvious dysplasia
Basophils not clearly identified in this field; few red cells in background
2815.describe_en: The smear shows a prominent granulocytic population spanning myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, with several larger immature cells having finer chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. Dysgranulopoiesis is not evident. Basophils are not clearly identified in this field, and the proportion of blasts cannot be established without a differential count. Findings are compatible with CML showing marked left shift; accelerated phase requires quantitative criteria.

ddx.vs: Chronic and accelerated phase share this morphology; blasts 10-19%, basophils >=20%, persistent thrombocytopenia or additional clonal abnormalities define accelerated phase.
Reactive granulocytosis shows toxic granulation, fewer myelocytes and no basophilia, and is BCR::ABL1-negative.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis and is BCR::ABL1-negative.

2431.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑之間的髓腔被大片淡粉紅色、顆粒狀的壞死物填滿，只剩少數散在的深染核，正常造血與脂肪結構消失，符合骨髓壞死。
features: Intertrabecular spaces filled with extensive pale eosinophilic, granular amorphous material
Marked loss of nuclear staining with only scattered residual hematoxylin-stained nuclei
Loss of normal hematopoietic architecture; few preserved fat spaces
Thin bony trabeculae present; bone itself appears intact at this power
No fibrosis or inflammatory reaction evident at this magnification
2431.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows thin bony trabeculae with intertrabecular marrow spaces diffusely replaced by pale eosinophilic, granular necrotic material. Only scattered residual nuclei are visible, and normal hematopoietic elements and fat architecture are largely effaced. No fibrosis or inflammatory response is apparent at this magnification. Findings are consistent with extensive bone marrow necrosis; osteocyte viability in the trabeculae and any viable foci should be assessed at higher power for an underlying cause.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation is lightly basophilic/pink homogeneous ground substance with atrophic fat cells, without granular necrotic debris and ghost cells.
Hemorrhage consists of intact red cells, often at the biopsy site, rather than granular anucleate debris.
Fibrosis shows streaming spindle cells and collagen/reticulin with viable nuclei rather than anucleate granular necrosis.

2303.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆顆粒密集、紫藍色的血小板，直徑明顯大於旁邊的一般血小板，接近紅血球大小，沒有細胞核，是大型／巨大血小板，常見於骨髓增生性腫瘤如 CML。
features: Single enlarged platelet in the center, several times the size of adjacent normal platelets and approaching red cell diameter
Densely packed purple azurophilic granules with a slightly irregular, fuzzy outline
No nucleus identified
Several small normal-sized platelets nearby for comparison
Background red cells with overlapping and stacked forms
2303.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single markedly enlarged platelet with densely granular purple cytoplasm and a slightly irregular outline, approaching the diameter of adjacent red cells and much larger than nearby normal platelets. No nucleus is present. Red cells are otherwise without specific abnormality in this field. Findings represent a giant (large) platelet, a nonspecific finding that in the context of CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, reflects abnormal megakaryopoiesis in a myeloproliferative neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Inherited forms show uniformly large platelets with thrombocytopenia, and MYH9 disorders show Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions, rather than isolated giant platelets in a myeloproliferative setting.
These contain a dense nucleus, whereas this cell is anucleate granular cytoplasm only.
Clumps show several individual platelet outlines aggregated together rather than one continuous granular cell.
ITP produces large young platelets with low counts but no granulocytic left shift or basophilia, and lacks BCR-ABL1.

2047.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆小淋巴球，核圓、染色質呈粗塊狀（clumped chromatin）、細胞質僅一圈薄邊；箭頭所指為一顆稍大、細胞質略多的淋巴球，仍無明顯核仁，整體符合 CLL 的小型成熟淋巴球。
features: Increased small lymphocytes, slightly larger than red cells
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Round nuclei with coarsely clumped (block-like) chromatin
Nucleoli not conspicuous
Arrow marks a slightly larger lymphocyte with more abundant cytoplasm but similar chromatin
Red cells normocytic; a platelet overlies a red cell near the arrow
2047.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased small mature-appearing lymphocytes with high N:C ratio, a thin rim of pale cytoplasm, round nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli. The arrow highlights a slightly larger lymphocyte with more abundant cytoplasm but similar condensed chromatin. Prolymphocytes with prominent nucleoli are not evident in this field, and smudge cells are not seen here. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology of individual cells overlaps; CLL is established by absolute B-lymphocytosis with CD5+, CD23+, CD200+ dim sIg light chain-restricted cells on flow cytometry.
MCL cells tend to show nuclear irregularity and less block-like chromatin and are CD23 negative, CD200 negative, cyclin D1 positive.
Prolymphocytes are larger with moderately condensed chromatin and a single prominent central nucleolus, which the arrowed cell does not clearly show.

1663.recognize_zh: 周邊血液兩顆中型淋巴球：核圓、染色質中度凝集（比母細胞粗），細胞質中等量淡藍；下方細胞核中央可見一個核仁輪廓，這種「成熟染色質＋明顯單一核仁」的組合是前淋巴球（prolymphocyte）的線索。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells, roughly twice the diameter of a small lymphocyte
Round nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin, coarser than blast chromatin
Single central nucleolus suggested in the lower cell
Moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking in thicker areas
1663.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm; the lower cell shows a single central nucleolus. The chromatin is more mature than that of lymphoblasts. Findings are suggestive of prolymphocytes; in context of a marked lymphocytosis with more than 55% such cells this would suggest prolymphocytic leukemia, although B-PLL is no longer a distinct entity in WHO 2022 and cases are reclassified (e.g., as mantle cell lymphoma, CLL in progression or splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli). Flow cytometry and cyclin D1/CCND1 testing are required.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have finely dispersed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and are TdT/CD34-positive, whereas these cells have condensed chromatin with a distinct nucleolus.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid or leukemic
ddx.vs: Can look identical; cyclin D1 expression or t(11;14) identifies mantle cell lymphoma.
Prolymphocytes are admixed with a background of small mature CLL cells and smudge cells, with a CD5+/CD23+ dim-sIg phenotype.
