T-PLL cells are smaller with irregular nuclear outlines and cytoplasmic blebs and express T-cell markers with TCL1A rearrangement.

60927.recognize_zh: 大細胞的核呈心形凹陷、輕度摺疊，染色質細緻開放，比成熟單核球年輕；灰藍色細胞質豐富並帶細顆粒與小空泡，符合前單核球（promonocyte）。
features: Large cell, over twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Nucleus with a single shallow indentation (heart-shaped) and delicate folding
Finely granular, relatively open chromatin, less condensed than a mature monocyte; nucleolus indistinct
Moderate to abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and small vacuoles
A small dark irregular fragment at the lower edge of the cell (likely an overlying platelet or debris)
60927.describe_en: Peripheral blood (or aspirate) smear at high magnification shows a large mononuclear cell with an indented, heart-shaped nucleus and finely dispersed, relatively open chromatin without a distinct nucleolus. The cytoplasm is abundant and grey-blue with fine azurophilic granules and a few small vacuoles. Chromatin is more delicate than that of a mature monocyte, and no Auer rods are seen. A small dark fragment overlies the lower cell border. Findings are consistent with a promonocyte, which is counted as a blast equivalent.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes have more condensed, clumped chromatin and more deeply folded or lobulated nuclei.
Monoblasts have a round nucleus with very fine chromatin, one or more prominent nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm.
Granulocytic precursors have a paranuclear hof and coarser pink or azurophilic granules, and cytochemically are MPO strong/nonspecific esterase negative.

127.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片紅血球系增生，可見晚期紅血球母細胞含兩個大小相近的圓形核（雙核紅血球母細胞，binucleated erythroblasts），另有核分葉或不規則的紅血球母細胞；搭配周邊血中有核紅血球與網狀紅血球反應不足，指向 CDA type II。
features: Marked erythroid hyperplasia with erythroblasts at all stages of maturation
Late (polychromatic/orthochromatic) erythroblasts with two equal-sized round nuclei (binucleation)
Occasional erythroblasts with lobulated or irregular nuclear contours
Peripheral blood: nucleated red cell, mild anisopoikilocytosis with irregular, crenated and fragmented red cells
Normal-appearing granulocytic maturation in the background
Sanger chromatogram with a single clean peak at the highlighted SEC23B exon 12 position (homozygous base call)
127.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild anisopoikilocytosis with irregular and crenated red cells, occasional fragments and a circulating nucleated red cell. The bone marrow aspirate shows marked erythroid hyperplasia with erythroblasts at all stages of maturation. Numerous late erythroblasts are binucleated with two nuclei of similar size, and occasional erythroblasts show lobulated nuclear contours; granulocytic maturation appears unremarkable. The accompanying Sanger chromatogram of SEC23B exon 12 shows a single non-overlapping peak at the highlighted position, indicating a homozygous base call; the displayed base (A) should be read against the reference and strand orientation, since the reported c.1385A>G variant would appear as G on the coding strand. Findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II.

ddx.vs: Shows internuclear chromatin bridges and megaloblastoid erythroblasts with spongy 'Swiss cheese' heterochromatin on EM, rather than predominant late binucleated erythroblasts; CDAN1/CDIN1 mutations.
Also reduced EMA binding and hemolysis, but marrow erythroblasts lack significant binucleation and reticulocytosis is appropriate.
Erythroblasts are large with open, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony plus giant metamyelocytes, not normoblastic binucleated late erythroblasts.
Multinucleated erythroblasts occur in adults with cytopenias, ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetic/molecular changes, not a lifelong congenital picture with SEC23B variants.

captions: Peripheral blood: nucleated red cell with mild anisopoikilocytosis and irregular red cells
Bone marrow aspirate: marked erythroid hyperplasia with erythroblasts at all stages
Bone marrow aspirate: binucleated late erythroblasts and a lobulated erythroblast nucleus
Sanger chromatogram of SEC23B exon 12 with the variant position highlighted

63.recognize_zh: 十二指腸黏膜固有層內有境界清楚、由單調小型有裂痕中心細胞（centrocytes）組成的濾泡狀結節，把絨毛撐開；免疫染色顯示結節 B 細胞瀰漫陽性、CD10 弱陽性、生發中心標記核陽性，符合十二指腸型濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Small-bowel mucosa with well-circumscribed, expanded lymphoid follicles occupying the lamina propria and distending villi
Follicles composed predominantly of small to medium centrocytes with angulated, cleaved nuclei and scant cytoplasm; few centroblasts (low-grade)
Monotonous follicles without obvious tingible-body macrophages or polarization; attenuated mantle
Overlying villous epithelium intact with lymphoid cells extending into adjacent villous cores

IHC: diffuse strong B-cell/BCL2-type staining throughout follicles and interfollicular areas; weak CD10 in follicles (brush border internal positive control); nuclear germinal-center marker (likely BCL6) in follicular cells
63.describe_en: Duodenal biopsy shows small intestinal mucosa with intact villous epithelium overlying well-circumscribed, expanded lymphoid follicles in the lamina propria, with lymphoid cells spilling into adjacent villous cores. At high power the follicles consist of a monotonous population of small to medium-sized centrocytes with irregular, angulated nuclei and scant cytoplasm, with only rare centroblasts; tingible-body macrophages are not conspicuous. Immunohistochemistry shows diffuse strong staining of the follicular and interfollicular lymphoid cells with B-cell/BCL2-type markers, weak CD10 in follicle cells (with strong CD10 on the enterocyte brush border), and nuclear positivity for a germinal-center marker within follicles. Findings are consistent with duodenal-type follicular lymphoma, low grade.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles show polarization, tingible-body macrophages, high Ki-67 and BCL2-negative germinal centers, unlike the monotonous BCL2-positive follicles here.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma (MALT lymphoma) with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma has marginal-zone/monocytoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and is CD10-/BCL6- in the neoplastic population, whereas neoplastic cells here are CD10+/BCL6+.
Mantle cell lymphoma is CD5+ and cyclin D1/SOX11+ and lacks CD10/BCL6, despite also presenting as small-cell nodules in GI mucosa.

ddx.dx: Systemic follicular lymphoma secondarily involving the duodenum
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; distinction requires staging showing no nodal/marrow disease and features such as IgA/memory B-cell-like profile, whereas systemic FL has disseminated disease.

captions: Low power: expanded lymphoid follicles in duodenal lamina propria beneath villi (H&E)
High power: monotonous centrocytes with angulated cleaved nuclei (H&E)
Diffuse strong staining of follicle and interfollicular lymphoid cells (likely CD20)
CD10: strong brush border staining with weak staining of follicular cells
Nuclear germinal-center marker (likely BCL6) concentrated in the follicle
Strong cytoplasmic/membranous staining of lymphoid infiltrate with negative epithelium (likely BCL2)

61759.recognize_zh: 這是一張上腹部 PET/CT 融合軸切面（非形態圖）：脾臟明顯腫大且 FDG 攝取瀰漫性增加、高於肝臟，脊椎椎體骨髓攝取也升高，腹腔動脈附近與腹膜後有數個小淋巴結 FDG 攝取；這種脾臟、骨髓與淋巴結同時高代謝的分布，符合母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤的廣泛侵犯。
features: Fused axial PET/CT image at the level of the upper abdomen
Marked splenomegaly with diffuse, heterogeneous FDG uptake exceeding that of the liver
Increased FDG uptake in the vertebral body, suggesting marrow involvement
Several small FDG-avid upper abdominal/retroperitoneal lymph nodes near the celiac axis and crura
Liver shows moderate background uptake without discrete focal lesions in this slice
61759.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic fused axial PET/CT image through the upper abdomen. It shows marked splenomegaly with diffuse, heterogeneous FDG uptake greater than hepatic background, increased uptake in the vertebral marrow, and several small FDG-avid upper abdominal and retroperitoneal lymph nodes. No discrete focal hepatic lesion is seen in this slice. In the context of biopsy-proven blastoid mantle cell lymphoma, the pattern is consistent with extensive splenic, nodal and likely bone marrow involvement by an FDG-avid aggressive lymphoma; SUV quantification and marrow biopsy correlation are required for staging.

ddx.vs: Classic MCL is often only modestly FDG-avid, whereas blastoid/pleomorphic variants show higher SUV, but the distinction rests on histology and Ki-67.

ddx.dx: Reactive splenic and marrow uptake (G-CSF therapy, infection, hemophagocytosis)
ddx.vs: Cytokine-driven or reactive uptake is diffuse and homogeneous without FDG-avid lymphadenopathy and resolves on follow-up, requiring clinical correlation.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma or other indolent lymphoma
ddx.vs: Indolent splenic lymphomas cause splenomegaly with usually low-grade FDG uptake and are separated by histology and immunophenotype (CD5, cyclin D1, SOX11).
DLBCL is similarly FDG-avid, so PET cannot separate it from blastoid MCL; cyclin D1/SOX11 and CCND1 rearrangement are needed.

61439.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆明顯增大的原紅血球（giant pronormoblast），核內染色質被推向核膜邊緣，核中為淡紫、細顆粒狀的毛玻璃樣包涵體，周圍有深藍細胞質環；這是微小病毒 B19（parvovirus B19）感染的典型核內包涵體。
features: Single markedly enlarged erythroid precursor (giant pronormoblast) in the center of the field
Nucleus with pale, finely granular/vacuolated glassy intranuclear inclusion and chromatin margination
Rim of amphophilic to basophilic cytoplasm surrounding the enlarged nucleus
Background marrow with mixed hematopoietic cells, scattered eosinophilic precursors, and adipocytes
Golden-brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages scattered in the background
61439.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a mixed hematopoietic background with adipocytes and scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages. In the center there is a markedly enlarged erythroid precursor with a large nucleus containing a pale, glassy, finely granular intranuclear inclusion with peripheral chromatin margination, surrounded by a rim of basophilic cytoplasm. Maturing erythroid precursors are not conspicuous in this field. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection; confirmation by parvovirus immunohistochemistry or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm, whereas the parvovirus-infected pronormoblast has a round nucleus with a glassy intranuclear inclusion and a thin basophilic rim.
CMV produces cytomegaly in endothelial/stromal cells with a single dense owl-eye nuclear inclusion and a halo, often with cytoplasmic inclusions.
Shows sheets of proerythroblasts without viral inclusions and with p53 overexpression/TP53 mutation, rather than scattered giant pronormoblasts with erythroid aplasia.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor cell or Reed-Sternberg-like cell
ddx.vs: These show prominent macronucleoli, cohesive clusters, or appropriate IHC markers rather than a glassy intranuclear inclusion with erythroid (E-cadherin/glycophorin) lineage.

62719.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀的點狀圖（非形態）：在 blast gate 中以 nTdT 對 CD34 作圖，芽細胞整群 TdT 呈連續的弱至中度表現，其中一部分（紅色）CD34 陽性，呈現異質性的不成熟表型，需與其他 B 系與骨髓系標記合併判讀混合表型急性白血病。
features: Dot plot of gated blasts: nuclear TdT (FITC) on x-axis versus CD34 (PC7) on y-axis
Blast events show a continuous spread of TdT expression from about 10^3 to above 10^4
Red-colored subpopulation extends upward into CD34-positive range (about 10^3 to 5x10^4)
Green-colored subpopulation is predominantly CD34-dim to negative
Heterogeneous CD34 expression within the blast gate suggests more than one maturational subset
62719.describe_en: This flow cytometry dot plot shows events gated as blasts, displaying nuclear TdT versus CD34. The blasts show a spread of TdT expression, with a red-colored subset that is CD34-positive and a larger green subset that is CD34-dim to negative. Without an isotype or internal negative control on this plot, the exact TdT positivity threshold cannot be defined from the image alone. This plot supports an immature blast population but is not lineage-defining; assignment of mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid requires MPO positivity plus strong CD19 with CD79a, cytoplasmic CD22, or CD10 on the same or a distinct blast population.

ddx.dx: B-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant myeloid antigens
ddx.vs: B-ALL may express CD13/CD33 but lacks MPO, whereas MPAL B/myeloid requires MPO (or monocytic markers) in addition to B-lineage criteria.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with aberrant CD19 or TdT
ddx.vs: AML with t(8;21) can show CD19 and TdT, but it lacks strong CD19 with strong CD79a/cCD22/CD10 required for B lineage, and recurrent genetic abnormalities take precedence.
Hematogones show an orderly maturational continuum from CD34+TdT+ to CD20+ cells without aberrant myeloid antigen or MPO expression.
